caption:
Global Metadata: A joyful, festive Mexican mariachi, 120 BPM, bright and brassy. Led by two trumpets playing a bold fanfare melody, backed by the vihuela (small five-string guitar), the guitarrón (large bass guitar), a guitar and light percussion. A passionate male voice sings a lively Spanish verse, the trumpets answer with a bright flourish, and the full mariachi plays a bold final refrain. Production profile: warm, close, festive mariachi recording, brilliant but not harsh trumpets, crisp strings, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a passionate, warm male singer in Spanish, natural and expressive, no auto-tune. No falsetto, no backing choir. The voice is central in the verse sections, absent in the trumpet-driven instrumental breaks.

Arrangement: Intro, the two trumpets play a bold fanfare over the vihuela and guitarrón. Verse one, the passionate male voice sings a lively Spanish verse, the trumpets answer with a bright flourish. Section two, a trumpet-led instrumental break with the mariachi strings. Verse two, the voice returns for a final verse. Outro, the full mariachi plays a bold final refrain and a crisp ending.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Two trumpets play a bold fanfare, vihuela and guitarrón

[Verse 1]
Ay, corazón, mi tierra cantando
el sol brilla fuerte en mi voz
vamos bailando, vamos soñando
la fiesta nos lleva a los dos

[Section 2]
Trumpet-led instrumental break, mariachi strings

[Verse 2]
Cantemos juntos, alegre el alma
el amor nos hace volar

[Outro]
Full mariachi, bold final refrain, crisp ending
